name: Distinct synthetic cohort
shall: The system shall provide one response for each of 5,000 unique fictional employee IDs and reconcile department counts to 5,000.
acceptance: 5,000 employee IDs, 5,000 response IDs and ten department counts match the declared fixture roster.

name: Authenticated mock collection
shall: All mock source routes shall require the public fake X-API-TOKEN. The workflow shall select the employees5000 export.
acceptance: Missing or wrong token returns 401; correct fake token returns the fixed export; unknown dataset is rejected.

name: Executable orchestration
shall: n8n shall run the collection through export, Bronze, Silver, Gold and visualization in order, from its manual trigger or published webhook. The dashboard shall call that webhook.
acceptance: The Execute control completes all stages; the webhook produces ready status; the dashboard displays the committed cohort.
evidence: Browser Execute evidence; cohort_smoke.main; dashboard browser walkthrough

name: Immutable Bronze and replay
shall: Bronze shall preserve the exact accepted export and distinct raw versions under a content-derived batch key. Identical reruns shall add no duplicate layer rows.
acceptance: A cohort replay retains one batch, 5,000 Bronze rows, 5,000 Silver rows and one cohort Gold snapshot.

name: Validated Silver records
shall: Silver shall select the newest response version before validation, reject invalid types or ranges, and quarantine invalid records without reviving older answers.
acceptance: All 5,000 fixed cohort responses pass; bad-score and invalid-newest tests quarantine the affected response.

name: Explicit sentiment metrics
shall: Gold shall calculate experience, CSAT and eNPS from completed responses with nonmissing answers to each question. Unknown denominators shall produce null.
acceptance: Independent arithmetic matches company and all ten department metrics, with 4,865 engagement, 4,828 CSAT and 4,879 eNPS answers.

name: Committed and traceable Gold
shall: Gold shall publish a versioned aggregate snapshot with the source batch hash, row counts and quality results before visualization is generated.
acceptance: Cohort snapshot reports survey-metrics-v2; publishing a visualization before Gold returns 409.

name: Interactive department analysis
shall: The dashboard shall filter departments and switch between experience, CSAT and eNPS, showing answered sample counts and a signed eNPS axis.
acceptance: All view shows ten rows; Engineering shows one row and 1,200 responses; negative eNPS values render left of zero.

name: Aggregate report exports
shall: The workflow shall generate HTML and CSV from committed Gold. Exports shall contain all departments and omit employee and response identifiers.
acceptance: CSV contains ten department rows totaling 5,000 responses; both exports download and contain no EMP_SYNTH or R_SAM_SYNTH identifiers.

name: Local failure notification
shall: A failed published workflow shall call the published error handler, which records a deduplicated operational notification in a local inbox.
acceptance: The intentional failure probe produces an inbox record; duplicate events do not duplicate notifications; payload and stack fields are rejected.

name: Guided reviewer pack
shall: A hiring manager shall be able to read a guided architecture diagram, BRD, requirements and execution walkthrough from the dashboard guide link or standalone documents.
acceptance: The guide loads; all six stage explanations and BR/FR identifiers appear; both Word downloads work; unknown download names are rejected.
evidence: test_manager_guide.py; guide browser walkthrough; rendered Word page inspection

name: Visible operating limits
shall: The pack shall state that this is a local synthetic full snapshot, with no live HR/vendor access, no measured ROI and no production release certification.
acceptance: Limitations are visible in the guide and both documents; local-only links and the fake token are explained.
evidence: Guide and document content review; source configuration inspection
